tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib, subprocess
addr = "[REDACTED:email]"
neutral = "user@example.org"
out = subprocess.run(["git","grep","-l",addr,"--","internal/","docs/"],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd="<repo>")
files = [f for f in out.stdout.split() if f]
for f in files:
    p = pathlib.Path("<repo>")/f
    t = p.read_text()
    n = t.count(addr)
    p.write_text(t.replace(addr, neutral))
    print(f, n, "replaced")
print("done")
EOF
tool_input.description: Replace personal email in fixtures via composed pattern
